verdict.rationale: GitLab documents several first-party self-hosting paths: the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator for Kubernetes, and self-compilation. It also provides recommended scaling configurations and a docs section on installing, configuring, updating, and maintaining an instance. Community users confirm running private and self-hosted instances, though one reported a backup regression in self-managed 8.15–8.16 that was later partly fixed. Missing for 10: detailed upgrade-path and backup/maintenance procedure evidence beyond a single summary line, and corroboration that recent upgrades are reliable.
